europe_now.title: Ukrainian drones strike deep into Russia
europe_now.summary: Ukrainian drones struck deep into Russia, killing at least 13 people in the Tatarstan region. The attacks highlight the ongoing cross-border conflict between Ukraine and Russia.

sources.headline: At least 13 killed in Ukrainian drone strike deep into Russia

top_stories.title: Spain and Italy increase border checks over Ceuta migration dispute
top_stories.summary: Spain and Italy have increased border checks following a dispute over the Ceuta migration crisis. The move reflects heightened tensions over immigration policy between the two EU member states.

sources.headline: Meloni, Frederiksen unite to condemn ‘uncontrolled immigration’ after Ceuta crisis

top_stories.title: Daniel Kinahan extradited to Ireland
top_stories.summary: Daniel Kinahan, a suspected crime boss, was extradited from Dubai to Ireland and charged in Dublin. His arrival marks a significant development in European law enforcement cooperation.
